sloka: त्वामप्येतादृशो भावः क्षिप्रमेव गमिष्यति ।जीवितान्तकरो घोरो दातारमिव दक्षिणा ॥२-६४-५७॥
transliteration: tvāmapyetādṛśo bhāvaḥ kṣiprameva gamiṣyati ।jīvitāntakaro ghoro dātāramiva dakṣiṇā ॥2-64-57॥

translations.english: 'Just like the merits of alms come to the giver, you are going to face very soon a dreadful situation causing the end of your life.'
